Definition: masculine plural of a derivative of G3007; remaining ones:--other, which remain, remnant, residue, rest.
BiblicalUsage: loipoí means the remaining ones — a small word with a sharp edge. In Matthew 22:6, "And the remnant took his servants"; and in Romans 11:7, "and the rest were blinded". In Revelation 20:5, "But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the rest are the ones God keeps His eye on — the remnant that did not bow, and the dead that lived not again until the thousand years were finished.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
